Product Features

  • Uniquely Designed Headboard: The bed body and headboard are covered with fine brushed cotton and linen beige fabric, which provides a portable and comfortable sleeping experience. The unique color-hopping design of the mustard yellow headboard creates a fresh atmosphere, and the button design on it gives you a different home decoration experience.
  • LED Lighting Design: The LED design is suitable for modern homes, and can also match the design of a game room. The remote control allows you to adjust different colors and brightness to give you a different home experience.
  • Built-in Charger: We have also added USB+Type-C charging ports on the sides of the headboard, which you can use to charge your smartphones, tablets and other electronic devices or charge them directly at your bedside. You no longer have to get up to charge your devices, saving you time and energy.
  • DURABLE: You can be sure that you are investing in a piece of furniture that will last a long time. The main frame is made of iron to ensure the stability of the bed with a load capacity of 660 lbs. The slatted base is made of resistant solid wood slats that provide comfortable support while sleeping.
  • Gas spring bed DESIGN: Huge storage space, large bed base under the folding slatted frame, plenty of storage space for blankets, pillows or sheets, the slatted frame is easy to fold with the lifting cylinder. An Oxford cloth is attached to the bottom of the bed to keep dust out.
  • Detailed information: This bed is available in 140*200cm/160*200cm sizes. To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame will be shipped in 2 cartons, which can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.
